en.title: Why Sharing Is Hard | Jesus Christ
en.description:
Is it really our duty to share what we have? This quote from Jesus challenges us to consider our responsibility towards those in need. When we hold onto excess while others go without, we risk missing the heart of compassion that Jesus exemplified. 

In a world filled with disparities, this message resonates deeply. It calls us to action, urging us to reflect on how we can contribute to the welfare of others. Sharing isn't just a nice idea; it's a command that can transform lives, including our own. 

What do you think sharing looks like in today’s society? How can we better support those in need? 

#Shorts #Christianity #Bible #Generosity #Compassion #Faith #SocialJustice #Love #Charity #Jesus #Sharing #Community #Blessings #HelpOthers #Hope
en.first_comment: This quote reminds us that our possessions are not just for our own comfort but for the benefit of others. Sharing can sometimes feel daunting, but it’s a powerful act of love. How have you experienced the joy of giving? Don’t forget to subscribe for more inspiring content!
